purpose: permanent source-based mathematical accessibility regression reference; this file specifies semantics, not an implemented output evaluator

source.coordinate_system: PDF points, origin top left, page width 612, height 792; approximate boxes describe source regions, not required output coordinates
source.distribution: PDF unchanged; usage governed by the existing PERMISSIONS.md; rendered pages were kept local, not committed

conventions.occurrence_identity: each printed inline occurrence has its own CSV ID and occurrence anchor; identical expressions in different locations are not interchangeable; embedded subexpressions are not additionally counted as inline occurrences
conventions.isolated_variables: annotate a/h when typeset as mathematical variables outside existing larger expressions; ordinary Portuguese words a/e are prose
conventions.numbers: annotate all table numbers, all formula numbers and complete physical quantities with printed units; ordinary prose numerals, list numbers, equation labels, course title and page furniture remain textual/structural, not extra inline rows
conventions.units: 60 km/h, 2 horas and 1 hora retain their printed unit and quantity together; equivalent spoken units are allowed without changing magnitude
conventions.repetitions: one source occurrence may span output blocks but cannot discharge multiple source-occurrence requirements
conventions.literal_vs_semantic: literal_latex preserves printed content; math_latex separates the equation label; AST describes the intended structure of that literal, including original mathematical errors
conventions.punctuation: sentence commas/periods are not mathematical operands; decimal commas are numbers; equation tags and list numbering are structural
conventions.hyphenation: join introduzire-mos (p4) and ex-pressão (p5) as layout hyphenation; preserve mathematical minus signs and intervals
conventions.empty_cells: empty means an intentionally blank exercise slot; never fill it by calculation, by 0 or by a placeholder interpreted as source content
conventions.inline_rendering: inline is a source-content role. Complete quantities with units may remain accessible prose; equivalent MathML or spoken math may represent expressions if tied to the correct occurrence. The legacy as_math metric measures markup, not all valid accessible representations.

ordinal_grouping.ordinal: positive integer, unique and consecutive from 1 in each literal group; bool is not an ordinal
ordinal_grouping.order: reading_order is the authoritative editorial sequence inspected in the PDF: top-to-bottom, left-to-right within each line, row-major for tables. It breaks ties in shared line bands; CSV order and ID suffixes are not reading-order evidence
ordinal_grouping.geometry: non-overlapping source regions provide additional order evidence; overlapping line bands use the explicit editorial sequence. No coordinate equality with transformed outputs is required

ast_schema.node: op plus optional args and named attributes; all args are nodes; number.literal keeps decimal notation

operators.multiply: ordered factors; notation implicit or dot as printed; multiplication is not function application
operators.equality_chain: ordered equal members; every printed equality stage survives
operators.domain: named Dom operator applied to function
operators.limit: variable,target,body; approach from both sides in these printed limits
operators.negate: unary minus; not subtraction from a missing operand
operators.ellipsis: source omitted intermediate steps, not a computed step
